name: Besudeltes Pergament
summary: A messenger leaves a marked parchment while you are away, and your teacher Nartok wants to speak with you. Its words challenge Thrall’s rule and warn of the danger faced by those who wield warlock power.

sections.title: A message waits
sections.body: The parchment is said to come from Nartok, your new teacher. You are asked to read it and speak with him in the Den in the Valley of Trials. Nartok speaks of orcs as a proud people and argues that Thrall turns away from power that could make the land theirs.

sections.title: A place among them
sections.body: Nartok says you have joined their ranks, but warns that access to warlock power will not make you welcome. Thrall allows warlocks into Orgrimmar because they remain orcs; Nartok cautions you that recklessness can be fatal. He remains available if you need instruction in spellcasting.

faq.answer: The parchment is believed to come from Nartok, your new teacher.

faq.q: Where can I speak with Nartok?
faq.answer: Nartok is in the Den in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: What does Nartok think of Thrall?
faq.answer: Nartok says Thrall turns away from power that could make the land theirs.

faq.q: Why does Thrall allow warlocks into Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Nartok says Thrall allows warlocks into Orgrimmar because they are still orcs.
Nartok warns that access to warlock power does not ensure acceptance, and that recklessness can be fatal.
Nartok says you can seek him again if you need instruction in spellcasting.

angles.text: As a warlock, Nartok’s warning concerns the power you wield and the danger of acting recklessly.
